description:
tapnow.ai_official on August 10, 2026: "From Cannes to Venice, TapNow’s Parallel Universes continue to unfold.

This year, TapNow is bringing The 10,000 Parallel Universes Initiative to the next global stage of cinema.

On September 4, TapNow will join hands with HappyHorse @HappyHorseAI at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival Production Bridge to host the official AI cinema forum:
AI x Cinema: The 10,000 Parallel Universes Initiative

Together with leading filmmakers, industry partners, and HappyHorse technical experts from around the world, we will explore the future of filmmaking in the age of AI and officially launch The 10,000 Parallel Universes global film incubation initiative in the European film industry.

We will also host:
🎬10,000 Parallel Universes Official Screening
🍹Parallel Universe Cocktail Reception

Submissions for The 10,000 Parallel Universes Season I are closing soon.
Whether you are building a short film or the beginning of a future feature-length story, all you need is a trailer to enter. Your work could be seen on the international stage in Venice by the global film industry.

Every story seed deserves its own universe.
In these final days, let your parallel universe rise above the horizon.
